entities.summary: St. Dominic's Cathedral, locally known as the Fanchuanpu Catholic Church, is located by the Min River, Fuzhou, Fujian, China. It is the seat of the Metropolitan Archdiocese of Fuzhou and the Ecclesiastical Province of Fuzhou.
